findings.claim: The supplied audit compares geometric nearest-teacher selection under sparse salient fields against Hungarian fixed-frame RMS with leave-one-batch exclusion over 14 independent batches; the compressed-choice excess fixed-RMS is positive (whole-window mean ~0.081 A, batch-bootstrap CI95 ~[0.070, 0.092]), so selection enrichment is a relative contrast, not an absolute geometric descriptor.

Chosen-teacher score correlations are weak and observational (compressed ~0.102, full ~0.064), and the audit explicitly states these are not a fitted or independently validated affinity predictor; therefore no supplied evidence establishes that coordinate selection improves final predicted target affinity.

Lineage support covers 14 complete-survival batches over 700 batch nodes, but 349 nodes have fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 fewer than 6, and terminal metadata show a single future-resampling node per batch at terminal score time 0.99; ancestral coverage is sparse and last-record credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

Curve support selects 24 features under an explicit rule (absolute integrated z >= 0.1, batch direction fraction >= 0.857, q < 0.05, scale floor excluded) with a fidelity rule of relative RMSE <= 0.35 and zero strong sign conflicts; the fidelity audit contents are container-summary only and were not read numerically.

hypotheses.falsifier: Batch-bootstrap CI95 for compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A includes zero or reverses sign.
hypotheses.observable: compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A and top4_teacher_overlap at observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: Signed favorable-versus-comparison coordinate contrasts at observed selection nodes over the complete observed window [0.0, 0.5] are enriched relative to a fixed-frame Hungarian RMS baseline, but this enrichment is a selection contrast rather than an absolute geometric or affinity descriptor.

hypotheses.falsifier: Survival effects and selection contrasts agree in sign across batches with adequate ancestral coverage.
hypotheses.observable: survival field/measure effects versus selection-node contrast signs
hypotheses.statement: Immediate selection evidence and available descendant survival credit may disagree in direction, and without decoded terminal labels the last-record credit must not be reported as final affinity benefit.

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied; final predicted target affinity benefit is unobserved and last-record/survival credit is not equivalent to it.

The information audit metrics are diagnostic geometric comparisons, not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian, and nonnegative excess distance is by construction rather than a causal affinity effect.
Curve fidelity audit contents were delivered as a container summary only and were not read numerically.
No current study outcome data are available to this role; no temperature or executable-source proposal is made.
